usageNotes: Use this to list all HA placement rules defined in the cluster, optionally filtering by rule type or the specific resource they govern. Requires Sys.Audit on the root path — available to any read-only audit token. Returns a flat list of rule identifiers; use a sibling endpoint to fetch individual rule details.

examples.summary: List all node-affinity rules in the cluster

tips: The 'resource' filter accepts HA resource IDs (e.g. 'vm:100') — useful when troubleshooting why a specific VM is pinned to certain nodes.
Rule identifiers returned here are child links; query /cluster/ha/rules/{rule} to retrieve the full rule configuration.
HA rules only apply to resources already registered under /cluster/ha/resources — verify resource membership there if a rule appears to have no effect.
